name: Aia's Tower
title: Aia's Tower
summary: Aia's Tower, built by the Empyrean architect Saolor Lentain (acpedia), reached in game through the Tower Base Dungeon (its portal is at the mesa foot, 92 m north). In the kit it is a row of five Empyrean towers (0x01002D37-39, 34-74 m tall with tops at z 152-192, stone head statues on the tops) standing E-W across a narrow mesa top at z 113-118 that rises 70-90 m out of a treed grass plain (z 27-50). The 'Upper Tower' area on the central tower roof holds the Stone Plaque and the note from Tamian Wilmot; undead (Champions and Warlocks of the Blood) spawn on it. Landblocks west (0xA7xx) and north (0xA855-0xAA55) are missing from the kit, so every camera stays south and east of the tower within 250 m.

site.name: Aia's Tower
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the open plain 139 m south of the tower row (ground + 0.5); the gazetteer upper-tower teleport lands inside a tower prism and tower-base-dungeon-portal is a portal swirl.

shots.standingOrder: Hover 120 m over the plain 250 m south of the mesa and tilt up from the slope to the five towers of Aia standing on the cliff, easing 20 m forward; stay 100 m above every tree, birds and creatures may be faded.
shots.notes: Opener for the most dramatic structure of the batch: five Empyrean towers (34-74 m tall, tops at z 152-192) standing on a narrow 80 m-high mesa above the grass plain. The tilt starts on the treed slope below the cliff and rises to the full mesa-and-towers silhouette; noon sun high in the south lights the south faces. The tower row centre enters the frame at about t 5.2 (reveal by design; the edit window opens 0.7 s before it, on the cliff face). shots.standingOrder: Hold the lens 1.5 m off the plain 100 m south of the mesa and look straight up the cliff to the towers against the sky while the frame rolls 10 degrees; keep 25 m from the trees at the cliff foot, creatures may be faded.
